1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.WedgeCoordinates
2 
3 /-! One complete planar wedge step: rotate the arms, add the next kite,
4 and express the result as a wedge about the new root. The hypotheses state
5 the angular order and the angle budget; the cut-surface construction must
6 still supply those facts at actual tree junctions.
7 -/
8 
9 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge
10 
11 open Real Set
12 
13 /-- Scaling a ray's direction by a positive number does not change the region. -/
14 theorem region_rescale (h r a b : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (positive : 0 < c) :
15     region h r (c * a) (c * b) = region h r a b := by
16   have negative : c * a < 0 ↔ a < 0 := by
17     simpa using (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ positive : c * a < c * 0 ↔ a < 0)
18   ext z
19   simp only [region, mem_setOf_eq, mul_assoc, mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left positive,
20     mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left positive, negative,
21     mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ positive]
22 
23 namespace ArmCoordinates
24 
25 variable {h r a b d θ γ : ℝ} (C : ArmCoordinates h r a b d θ γ)
26 include C
27 
28 /-- The source direction increases when the root moves to the right. -/
29 theorem source_direction_mono {q D Θ : ℝ} (order : r ≤ q) (radius : 0 < D)
30     (angle_pos : 0 < Θ)
31     (source_x : -q = D * cos Θ) (source_y : h = D * sin Θ) : θ ≤ Θ := by
32   have product : d * D * sin (Θ - θ) = h * (q - r) := by
33     rw [sin_sub]
34     rw [C.source_y, show r = -(d * cos θ) by linarith [C.source_x],
35       show q = -(D * cos Θ) by linarith [source_x]]
36     have heights : d * sin θ = D * sin Θ := C.source_y.symm.trans source_y
37     nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => d * cos θ * x) heights]
38   have sine : 0 ≤ sin (Θ - θ) := by
39     have nonnegative := mul_nonneg C.height_pos.le (sub_nonneg.mpr order)
40     rw [← product] at nonnegative
41     exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left (mul_pos C.radius_pos radius)).mp nonnegative
42   by_contra backwards
43   have negative := sin_neg_of_neg_of_neg_pi_lt (by linarith : Θ - θ < 0)
44     (by linarith [C.angle_lt_pi] : -π < Θ - θ)
45   linarith
46 
47 /-- The same outer rays, seen from the new root, have angle `γ + (Θ - θ)`.
48 Their directions are rescaled only to match the new inner-leg length. -/
49 theorem moved_coordinates {q D Θ : ℝ} (radius : 0 < D)
50     (angle_pos : 0 < Θ) (angle_lt_pi : Θ < π)
51     (source_x : -q = D * cos Θ) (source_y : h = D * sin Θ)
52     (lower : π / 2 ≤ γ + (Θ - θ)) (upper : γ + (Θ - θ) ≤ 3 * π / 2) :
53     ArmCoordinates h q (D / d * a) (D / d * b) D Θ (γ + (Θ - θ)) := by
54   refine ⟨radius, angle_pos, angle_lt_pi, lower, upper, source_x, source_y, ?_, ?_⟩
55   · rw [show Θ + (π - (γ + (Θ - θ))) = θ + (π - γ) by ring, C.ray_x]
56     field_simp [ne_of_gt C.radius_pos]
57   · rw [show Θ + (π - (γ + (Θ - θ))) = θ + (π - γ) by ring, C.ray_y]
58     field_simp [ne_of_gt C.radius_pos]
59 
60 /-- The new angle bound supplies the second outward condition in `root_step`. -/
61 theorem next_outward {q D Θ : ℝ} (radius : 0 < D)
62     (angle_pos : 0 < Θ) (angle_lt_pi : Θ < π)
63     (source_x : -q = D * cos Θ) (source_y : h = D * sin Θ)
64     (lower : π / 2 ≤ γ + (Θ - θ)) (upper : γ + (Θ - θ) ≤ 3 * π / 2) :
65     0 ≤ h * b - q * a := by
66   have next := (C.moved_coordinates radius angle_pos angle_lt_pi source_x source_y lower upper).outward
67   have positive := div_pos radius C.radius_pos
68   have factored : 0 ≤ D / d * (h * b - q * a) := by nlinarith [next]
69   exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left positive).mp factored
70 
71 /-- The angle increase is the ordinary angle at the upper apex of the kite. -/
72 theorem kite_apex_angle {q D Θ : ℝ} (order : r ≤ q) (radius : 0 < D)
73     (angle_pos : 0 < Θ) (angle_lt_pi : Θ < π)
74     (source_x : -q = D * cos Θ) (source_y : h = D * sin Θ) :
75     EuclideanGeometry.angle (point r 0) (point 0 h) (point q 0) = Θ - θ := by
76   have old : point r 0 - point 0 h = -(d • direction θ) := by
77     ext i
78     fin_cases i <;> simp [point, direction, PiLp.sub_apply, C.source_y,
79       show r = -(d * cos θ) by linarith [C.source_x]]
80   have next : point q 0 - point 0 h = -(D • direction Θ) := by
81     ext i
82     fin_cases i <;> simp [point, direction, PiLp.sub_apply, source_y,
83       show q = -(D * cos Θ) by linarith [source_x]]
84   change InnerProductGeometry.angle (point r 0 - point 0 h) (point q 0 - point 0 h) = _
85   rw [old, next, InnerProductGeometry.angle_neg_neg,
86     InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_left_of_pos _ _ C.radius_pos,
87     InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_right_of_pos _ _ radius]
88   exact direction_angle θ Θ
89     (sub_nonneg.mpr (C.source_direction_mono order radius angle_pos source_x source_y))
90     (by linarith [C.angle_pos])
91 
92 /-- Rotation, exact addition of the next kite, and separation before addition.
93 All three regions are explicit sets of points in the same Euclidean plane. -/
94 theorem rotate_and_move {q D Θ lower upper : ℝ}
95     (order : r ≤ q) (radius : 0 < D) (angle_pos : 0 < Θ) (angle_lt_pi : Θ < π)
96     (source_x : -q = D * cos Θ) (source_y : h = D * sin Θ)
97     (lower_moves : θ ≤ lower) (upper_moves : upper ≤ 2 * π - θ)
98     (budget : γ + EuclideanGeometry.angle (point r 0) (point 0 h) (point q 0) ≤ 3 * π / 2) :
99     let α := EuclideanGeometry.angle (point r 0) (point 0 h) (point q 0)
100     let W : Set Plane := {z | z - point r 0 ∈ polarRegion d γ lower upper}
101     let V : Set Plane := {z | z - point r 0 ∈ polarRegion d γ θ (2 * π - θ)}
102     let W' : Set Plane := {z | z - point q 0 ∈
103       polarRegion D (γ + α) Θ (2 * π - Θ)}
104     W ⊆ V ∧ Disjoint V (interior (kite h r q)) ∧ W' = V ∪ kite h r q := by
105   rw [C.kite_apex_angle order radius angle_pos angle_lt_pi source_x source_y] at budget ⊢
106   have increasing := C.source_direction_mono order radius angle_pos source_x source_y
107   have lower_bound : π / 2 ≤ γ + (Θ - θ) := by linarith [C.lower]
108   have next := C.moved_coordinates radius angle_pos angle_lt_pi source_x source_y lower_bound budget
109   have old_identity : {z | z - point r 0 ∈ polarRegion d γ θ (2 * π - θ)} =
110       region h r a b := by
111     ext z
112     exact (C.mem_region_iff_polar z).symm
113   have new_identity : {z | z - point q 0 ∈
114       polarRegion D (γ + (Θ - θ)) Θ (2 * π - Θ)} = region h q a b := by
115     rw [← region_rescale h q a b (div_pos radius C.radius_pos)]
116     ext z
117     exact (next.mem_region_iff_polar z).symm
118   refine ⟨fun z member => rotate_arms lower_moves upper_moves member, ?_⟩
119   change Disjoint _ _ ∧ _ = _
120   rw [old_identity, new_identity]
121   have step := root_step C.height_pos order C.outward
122     (C.next_outward radius angle_pos angle_lt_pi source_x source_y lower_bound budget)
123   exact ⟨step.2, step.1⟩
124 
125 end ArmCoordinates
126 end SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge
